summary: Post-execute repair: implemented 3 G3 parity fixes (Locked->Expanded click, pinned capped scrollable ListView, unsnapped drag work-area clamp) and one bounded memory optimization attempt (Tokio current-thread + minimal features). 128 tests pass, clippy clean, release builds. Bounded optimization FAILED to reduce memory: post-repair UI_SMOKE 37.0 MiB vs baseline UI_SMOKE 34.5 MiB under the same measurement condition. The +2.5 MiB delta is unexplained without a controlled runtime-only A/B. Original < 10 MiB gate remains unmet; normal release 33.66 MiB and UI_SMOKE 37.0 MiB both satisfy user-approved fallback acceptance < 40 MiB.

evidence.cargo_test: cargo test -p xhm-desktop: 128 passed, 0 failed (includes 3 new parity/clamp tests)
evidence.memory_post_repair_ui_smoke: 60 samples, same condition as baseline (release,winit-software,UI_SMOKE): min 37.039 MiB, max 37.277 MiB, 0/60 below 10 MiB (outputs/memory-samples-post-repair.json)
evidence.memory_post_repair_normal: 30 samples, release winit-software, no UI_SMOKE: min 33.656 MiB, max 33.660 MiB
evidence.memory_baseline_delta: baseline UI_SMOKE min 34.504 MiB -> post-repair UI_SMOKE min 37.039 MiB; delta +2.535 MiB; cause unproven (no controlled runtime-only A/B performed)
